answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The pulse multiplier is published, charged in whisper, and nectar lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 12 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 4379 identities would post 916 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
